INSERT INTO subscriptions (subscription_name, consumer_group_member, last_seen, updated_at, consumer_group_size, target_kind, target_category) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, now(), $4, $6, $5) ON CONFLICT (subscription_name, consumer_group_member)
DO UPDATE SET last_seen = GREATEST(subscriptions.last_seen, EXCLUDED.last_seen), updated_at = now(), consumer_group_size = EXCLUDED.consumer_group_size, target_kind = EXCLUDED.target_kind, target_category = EXCLUDED.target_category

WITH scanned AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT event_id, stream_version, original_stream_id, original_stream_version, category
  FROM stream_events
  -- stream_id is integral: this range selects exactly $all. Keeping both
  -- index keys in the ordering prevents custom tail plans from choosing
  -- the partial category index and sorting an unrestricted metadata scan.
  WHERE stream_id >= $5 AND stream_id < $6 AND stream_version > $1
  ORDER BY stream_id, stream_version LIMIT $4
), eligible AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM scanned WHERE stream_version <= $2
), progress AS (
  SELECT count(*)::int4 AS scanned_count,
         count(*) < $4 OR coalesce(max(stream_version) = $2, $7) AS exhausted,
         CASE WHEN count(*) < $4 OR coalesce(max(stream_version) = $2, $8)
              THEN $2 ELSE max(stream_version) END AS frontier
  FROM eligible
), matching AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM eligible
  WHERE (category COLLATE "C" = $3 OR starts_with(category COLLATE "C", $3 || $9)))
, payloads AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT m.stream_version,
         ROW(e.event_id, e.event_type, m.stream_version, m.stream_version,
             m.original_stream_id, m.original_stream_version,
             e.data, e.metadata, e.causation_id, e.correlation_id, e.created_at) AS event
  FROM matching m
  -- OFFSET 0 keeps event-id probes behind matching in generic plans.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM events WHERE event_id = m.event_id OFFSET $10) e ON $11
)
SELECT p.frontier, p.scanned_count, p.exhausted, payloads.event
FROM progress p
-- Generate the sentinel after payload probing, so an empty matching set
-- never invokes even a zero-I/O NULL event-id lookup.
LEFT JOIN payloads ON $12
ORDER BY payloads.stream_version
